The '''Neo-Tayans''' were a progressive faction of the [[Tayan League]] that took control of the party approximately 1,500 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and funded the creation of the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]]. Five hundred years into their leadership, a revolt broke out among the [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] colony, which ultimately led to the isolation of Kinyen and the loss of its colonies and wealth.<ref name="Strongholds" />
